items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Everybody was light -- like Willie Bryant -- did you ever see Willie Bryant, no.

ctx.x: but he worked on Keith's Circuit too, but it was just four of us on the stage and him and he played clarinet, three of them at one time. Beautiful. Stage setting, he had a beautiful stage setting, whole lot of drapes, but we used to have to get to the theatre an hour before showtime to get made up.

Boy, when we come on that stage, we waslight as a sheet of newspaper, ain't no way in the world you could tell us. Everybody was light -- like Willie Bryant -- did you ever see Willie Bryant, no. He used to be at that Apollo, He looked like a /white boy, light as Tizol. You saw Tizol.

So that's there, he had an engagement in Chicago or somewhere, but we wouldn't go. Said no, we ain't leaving New York, so he got somebody else, so in the meantime, it's summertime now, a person called Bricktop. You heard of Bricktop.
